name: file-lens
description: File size, type, timestamps and path in the status bar and file details

fileLens.useDecimal.description: Defaults to false, using IEC's representation. Set to true to get SI representation.

fileLens.use24HourFormat.description: Defaults to true, using 24-hour format. Set to false to get 12-hour format.

fileLens.showRawInBytes.description: Defaults to false, whether to show raw size in bytes in the detailed view.

fileLens.showCreatedInStatusBar.description: Show the active file's creation date in the status bar when available.

fileLens.displayInfoOnTheRightSideOfStat.description: Defaults to false, whether to show the filesize info on the right side of the status bar.

fileLens.showGzip.description: Defaults to true, whether to show gzip size in detailed view or not.

fileLens.showBrotli.description: Defaults to false, whether to show brotli size in the detailed view.

fileLens.showGzipInStatusBar.description: Defaults to false, whether to show gzip size in the status bar.

fileLens.showBrotliInStatusBar.description: Defaults to false, whether to show brotli size in the status bar.
